findings.message: [stale-entry] `hostTests.add` names `paddock-gone`, which is no member package of crates and no module of it
findings.fix: Delete the entry or fix its spelling: a typo here silently drops that code's host tests.

findings.message: [redundant-exception] `hostTests.add` lists `paddock-a`, which the code already marks as OS-specific
findings.fix: Delete the entry from crates/paddock.ci.json: the placement is derived, only what the code cannot say is declared.

name: an-only-macos-package-with-windows-code-and-one-without
files: {"hostTests": {"only": [{"os": "macos-latest", "name": "paddock-a", "reason": "a reason that is long enough"}, {"os": "macos-latest", "name": "paddock-b", "reason": "a reason that is long enough"}]}}

findings.message: [os-code-windows] `paddock-a` is tested only on macOS (`hostTests.only`) but `paddock-a` holds Windows code: it would never run on Windows
findings.fix: Remove the `only` entry for `paddock-a` in crates/paddock.ci.json (it then runs on every host), or remove the Windows code.
